title: An unexpected question changes understanding

captions.physics: Opening with meaning still unclear acknowledged
captions.energy: Leaving a false measure of understanding
captions.emotions: Valuing a question now heard differently

meaning: You can open conversation by acknowledging unclear meaning and leave a false measure of understanding, feeling a question’s significance without endlessly explaining everything for both.
text: On your Vishuddha, the Fool in the physical position appears in unexpectedly acknowledging meaning still unclear. The Tower in energy supports a wish to leave a false measure of understanding: that one explanation must suffice. Judgement in emotions brings significance to a question heard anew. You can open another course and experience the right to clarify differently. This determines neither another person’s ability nor a duty immediately to know every cause of misunderstanding.

For example, a detailed explanation suddenly receives “May I still not understand this part?” You can name a particular word instead of a pretended ready “Clear”. **An honest question does not devalue an explanation already given**. A false connection between quantities of explanation and compulsory understanding becomes visible. An important response emerges: the question can have room without shame. Yet new significance does not make the first account useless; some meaning was heard while an unknown part allows a separate answer not prescribed beforehand.

Difficulty arises if a question’s importance demands endless explanation until inward clarity is complete. One false measure replaces another. Constructive Tower energy helps notice precisely an unconfirmed obligation while preserving actual participation. You can acknowledge not understanding and hear an answer’s limit; a new experience requires no identical discovery, while freedom allows clarification and a pause without promising every complex meaning understood immediately through the required formula.
